subject: Sales → CS: MedexHR activation brief and kickoff window
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MedexHR signed — quick activation summary + artifacts

Irene — MedexHR signed the SOW this morning (electronic signature completed). Quick summary so CS has context: 

- Customer: MedexHR (healthcare staffing platform)
- Pillars purchased: Hosted API (L), Dedicated pool (2x A100-equivalents), Optimize advisory (3 months)
- Start of paid term: 2028-04-01
- Annual committed spend: ~$480k (committed monthly billing)
- Primary contacts: Dr. Alex Rivera (Head of Product) and Procurement at procure@medexhr.com

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_MedexHR_20280328.pdf; Mutual_Action_Plan_MedexHR.xlsx; MedexHR_security_questionnaire_filled.pdf

Key things CS should know up front: 
1) Security: They requested SOC2 evidence and an architecture walkthrough. Questionnaire is attached and largely complete, but they have a custom retention ask (30 days for request logging, 90 days for inference logs) — flagged in the SOW as "integration requirement".
2) Go-live target: They want an internal pilot with 2 teams by 2028-04-18 and full ramp by 2028-05-15. Tight timeline.
3) Predictable latency requirement: 95th pctile < 220ms for short chat flow (max token length 256) on Dedicated config. We committed to a baseline SLA in the SOW.
4) Integrations: They will use our hosted routes initially, but want Dedicated for peak windows (scheduled daily job at 03:00 UTC).
5) Success criteria: pilot acceptance defined as 95% of pilot prompts returning with expected quality (per their eval harness) and steady latency.

Actions I need from CS: please take owner assignment and confirm kickoff date window (prefer 2028-04-02 to 2028-04-05). Also run the security checklist session with them (30–45m) and confirm KMS/HSM needs.

Marissa — I folded you in as likely owner based on your recent Dedicated migrations. If unavailable, please reassign.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Sales Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_SOW_MedexHR_20280328.pdf]
[Attachment: Mutual_Action_Plan_MedexHR.xlsx]
[Attachment: MedexHR_security_questionnaire_filled.pdf]

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MedexHR signed — quick activation summary + artifacts

Thanks Karthik — congratulations on closing. I can take point for the kickoff coordination.

I reviewed the attachments quickly. Two immediate notes: 
- The retention deviation in the SOW needs ops confirmation; I will loop infra during the kickoff.
- The latency SLO will likely require kernel/compilation tuning on the Dedicated pool — flagging as a risk for timeline.

Marissa — I'm assigning you as CS Engagement Lead for this account. Can you confirm acceptance and availability for a kickoff on either 2028-04-03 or 2028-04-04? If you accept, please schedule a 60-minute internal prep (CS + Infra + Sales) before the external kickoff.

For the kickoff agenda, propose we cover: 1) scope & success criteria, 2) security & retention specifics, 3) Dedicated sizing and schedule, 4) integration checklist (API keys, network config, whitelists), 5) pilot plan and acceptance tests. Please add/remove items.

Irene Choi
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Subject: Internal: MedexHR activation — prep checklist and risks (please review)

Marissa — moving to you as owner. Below is an internal prep checklist I want completed before the external kickoff (assign owners in reply):

1) Technical readiness (owner: Marissa / Infra): confirm Dedicated pool provisioning slot and initial node image. Verify 95th pctle latency target is feasible with our recommended instance shape.
2) Security & compliance (owner: Marissa / Security): run through attached questionnaire with Alex, confirm KMS/HSM requirements and logging retention MOU.
3) Integration stub (owner: Integration SE): confirm API keys, IP allowlist, webhooks for usage events, and define prefix caching expectations.
4) Pilot acceptance tests (owner: CS QA): translate MedexHR eval harness into 20 canonical prompts and acceptance thresholds.
5) Mutual action plan (owner: Marissa): update the attached Mutual_Action_Plan_MedexHR.xlsx with dates and owner names.

Known risks/notes (for prioritization):
- Tight timeline: pilot requested two weeks from today; resource contention possible if infra provisioning is delayed.
- Custom retention: requires infra storage policy exceptions and possibly a billing adjustment if retention beyond default increases cost.
- Third-party embedding service: they may route embeddings to an external vector DB; validate network policy for that integration.

Deliverables/timelines: internal prep complete by 2028-04-02 COB; external kickoff to happen no earlier than 2028-04-03.

Can you reply with owner assignments and confirm the internal prep meeting time (30–45m) today or tomorrow morning?

Irene

[Attachment: Mutual_Action_Plan_MedexHR.xlsx]
[Attachment: MedexHR_security_questionnaire_filled.pdf]

—Marissa
